description: SCOUT's accumulated shadow simulation, ported from SCOUT (urban-toolkit/scout): the Simulate Shadows node runs the Deep Umbra model from the Model Catalog on Rasterize Buildings' height tiles, and gives the minutes of the day the ground is in shadow, as a raster an Autark map draws, a table of tiles and SCOUT's metrics.
name: SCOUT Shadow Simulation

templates.description: SCOUT's shadow model: runs Deep Umbra, a Model Catalog model, on each height tile and its neighbours for a season. Input: Rasterize Buildings' (mosaic, tiles), at zoom 16 with a maximum height of 550 m. Output: (mosaic, tiles, summary): one RASTER of the minutes of the day each cell is in shadow, for an Autark map; a table with one row per tile (zoom, x, y, its shadow PNG in base64 and mean_shadow_min); and one row of SCOUT's metrics, the mean and median minutes of shadow on the ground.
templates.label: Simulate Shadows
